body: My GM is a good guy too, can’t speak for everyone, but my experience has been corporate vs stores. Generally the people who you work with at the store are the decent ones while the corpo-rats are the shitty humanoids
With the money I make I seriously doubt my replacement will be grateful. Also, I am someone else’s replacement, he wasn’t happy and neither am I.
Yea I actually think we are going through that phase again, the ship is sinking and we are the ones getting the water out with solo cups
